units.source_text: ……回到寺庙之前，我仍然落入恍惚之中。

en.t: ...Before returning to the temple, I still sank into a trance.

units.source_text: 乳房和金阁在我的心中交替地涌现。

en.t: The breasts and the Golden Pavilion rose up alternately in my mind.

units.source_text: 一种无力的幸福感充满了我的身心。

en.t: A powerless sense of happiness filled my body and mind.
